title: Ikarus: High-Precision 2-D RCWA Simulation for Periodic Photonic Structures
description: Ikarus is a high-precision 2-D rigorous coupled-wave analysis (RCWA / Fourier Modal Method) solver for periodic photonic structures -- metasurfaces, gratings, photonic-crystal slabs, thin-film stacks and metamirrors. It uses faithful Fourier factorization (the normal-vector / Fast-Fourier-Factorization method by default) for correct high-index-contrast TM convergence, with full vectorial polarization, anisotropic media, real-space field reconstruction and gradient-based inverse design.
